params.topic: Japan J1 League 2018-2025 football-only incremental gap supplement after req-20261002-015
questions: Scope gate: Japan J1 League only, competition_key=j1_league, seasons 2018 through 2025, expected 2670 fixtures. Exclude Bundesliga, every German competition, J2, J3, and cup competitions.

Return only row-level football data missing from req-20261002-015, joined by season, match date, home team, away team, and round when available. Preserve original labels, normalized identity, source URL, final URL, fetched_at, source hash, field semantics, and evidence locator.

Odds only: for Bet365, Pinnacle, and William Hill separately, seek earliest verified pre-match and latest verified pre-match 1X2 observations with recorded timestamps. Preserve true opening, pre-closing, closing, and page-displayed as distinct semantics. Build O_INTERVAL only when both endpoints are from the same bookmaker and same fixture. Never rename closing or pre-closing as opening. Prioritize P0 10 fixtures, P1 17 Bet365 fixtures, P2 1590 Pinnacle tick gaps, P3 1509 Bet365 closing gaps, and P4 1600 William Hill gaps.
Resolve the 48 J1 5Dollar provider_fixture_id values using a stable season/date/home/away/round crosswalk. Return provider IDs only with direct evidence; otherwise keep unresolved.

Resolve football standings context: 2020 missing rounds 23-26, 29, 32, 33; 61 fixtures with unresolved pre-match rank intervals; provide dated pre-kickoff points, played, rank, tie-break, H2H, discipline or draw evidence only when directly sourced. Never infer rank from post-kickoff outcomes.

Resolve football schedule context: 38 source-marked TBD venues, 545 empty kickoff times, explicit kickoff timezone for all rows when a source provides it, and 2025 R29-R38 preliminary schedule fields (98 kickoff TBD, 7 dates TBD, 43 nominal-date caveats). Preserve source-local time and timezone; do not infer timezone from country.

Return machine-readable row-level results, coverage audit totals by season and field, and an unresolved_queue for every remaining football field. Do not return or infer Qimen charts, palaces, F/G/I/Q/M tokens, natal_year, predictions, probabilities, Miss labels, BTTS, or outcome-derived model features. This request is supplemental football evidence only; do not run odds screening.
params.note_to_muse: Football data only. Muse cannot provide Qimen palaces or local chart fields; do not search for them. Do not merge with Bundesliga req-20261002-014 or any non-J1 competition. Preserve unavailable and conflicts explicitly.
